title: diplazium marojejyense
intro: Diplazium marojejyense, commonly known as the Madagascar chain fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Diplazium marojejyense are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
